changes: SceneViews publishes a separate resident display image only after a complete scene frame, using a same-device GPU copy. Private target writes cannot alter the current display. This adds one display image and a full image copy per completed frame; no CPU image/readback bridge.
Same-world tool/asset binding changes keep a passive last-complete image with no old controls or receipts. Different document/map/view/size scopes are excluded.

Material/Finish overlay choices change local application settings without parsing/publishing MZ recipes, texture refresh or history replay. Explicit per-stroke/stamp overrides persist across save/load; optional default-false markers preserve inherited recipe semantics and direct MZ authoring updates.

Play startup errors use explicit severity markers and immediately select Debug. Runtime log auto-selection requires an explicit error marker; warnings stay in the current sidebar. Existing theme red #fb4934/yellow #fabd2f verified.
Shared UI adapter requests an update after presentation so work admitted after the prior FrameRequest can proceed without input.
Terrain automatic ground selection excludes Paint/stamp tiles; preserves valid authored terrain source. Existing green neutral fallback remains when no valid ground tile exists.

Viewport owns a separate registration for the complete display image through atlas retirement. Scope changes revoke reuse; retired handles remain pinned by outstanding roots. Pending CPU geometry is detected before rendering into the reusable published image, preserving its pixels.
initial_regression_and_resolution: Removing material-default application broke direct MZ recipe-edit parity. Corrected with explicit override metadata: inherited paint continues following recipe edits while brush-selected overrides remain per placement. Both parity and new future-stroke regression now pass.
